game_tagline: Steal cars, draw a wanted level, lose the police.
saving_note: Cash, finished runs and your loadout save at Mara's safehouse.
viewfinder_hint: Aim with the mouse · Click to shoot · Wheel to zoom · Backspace to exit
board_hint: Mara's car is yours to borrow. No theft charge.
job_locked: Finish Mara's first run to earn this contact's trust.
job_abandoned: Contract abandoned. No payment; you can try again.
job_failed_wasted: You lost the cargo. The contact will offer another run.
job_failed_busted: The job was seized. Recover, then try again.
job_failed_clock: The pickup window closed. Mara can arrange another attempt.
job_wrong_car: Mike needs the marked car, not a replacement.
service_wrong_place: That's sold somewhere else: armour at Bay Supply, repairs and permits at Mike's Garage, saving at the safehouse.
service_no_cash: Not enough cash. Finish a contract first.
service_bring_car: Drive the car into Mike's garage first.
service_finish_job: Finish or abandon the current job before saving.
leave_body: Anything since your last safehouse save is lost: cash earned, contract progress and pickups.
services_note: Buy on site with no wanted level. Repair needs a parked car; the loading pass halves quiet loading time.
